info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Details-spec
info.description: This API endpoint enables users to access detailed information about specific accounts linked to customers. By using the customer's unique identifier and the corresponding account ID, clients can retrieve a comprehensive view of the account's attributes and status. Typical consumers of this API include account management systems and customer support applications that require quick access to account-level insights. This endpoint streamlines the process of obtaining account details, enhancing operational efficiency and customer service capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific account for a customer, identified by their unique customer and account IDs. Use this to obtain insights regarding account status, transactions, and other relevant data.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to retrieve detailed information about the specified account for the given customer. The structure of the request body must adhere to the defined schema, which outlines the necessary parameters and their types.

ListAccountDetailsRequest.description: The request body for retrieving details of a specific account for a customer in JSON format.

ListAccountDetailsResponse_200.title: Account Details Response

routingNumber.description: The routing number associated with the account.

realAccountNumber.description: The real account number of the customer.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the account response.

ListAccountDetailsResponse_200.description: A schema representing the details of an account response, including routing and account numbers, as well as metadata regarding the response.

Metadata.title: Response Metadata

correlationId.description: Identifier for correlating requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata related to the account response that provides context about the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the API endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: Name of the application responsible for handling the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which requires a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) to be passed in the Authorization header of the request. Upon successful authentication, access to secured endpoints is granted.
